title: Sales Ninja
summary: A Le Wagon Data Science & AI bootcamp project that builds a custom dashboard for the Contoso retail sales dataset. Its synthesis pipeline defines metadata, applies FixedCombinations/OneHotEncoding constraints, and fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate synthetic sales records, which it then validates with SDV's diagnostic and quality-report evaluation functions.
